# NeuroMirror

> NeuroMirror is a private writing and memory journal with optional AI-generated observations about a journal entry the user chooses. Its cognitive-language reflections are informational and are not a medical test, score, diagnosis, or prediction.

Canonical website: https://neuromirror.in/

## Public pages

- [Home](https://neuromirror.in/): Product overview, feature list, privacy summary, and frequently asked questions.
- [Cognitive health journal](https://neuromirror.in/cognitive-health-journal): What writing-led reflection can and cannot tell a user.
- [How cognitive writing analysis works](https://neuromirror.in/how-cognitive-analysis-works): User action, analysis data flow, and limitations.
- [Memory Vault guide](https://neuromirror.in/memory-vault-guide): Current search and memory organization features.
- [Privacy](https://neuromirror.in/privacy): Data storage, AI processing, and deletion information.

## Current product facts

- Users write private dated journals and undated notes in their own account.
- Gemini analysis runs only after a user selects a saved journal and explicitly asks for analysis.
- The analysis request includes the selected entry and up to five earlier analysis summaries from that account. It does not include other full journal entries, passwords, or account tokens.
- Memory Vault search is currently keyword-based. It does not use Gemini or semantic search.
- Individual journals and notes can be deleted. Account-wide deletion is not self-service in Settings; users can contact the site owner to request it. Data export is not currently available.
- NeuroMirror is not a medical device and does not diagnose or treat any condition.

## Privacy and indexing

- Journal and note records are private to authenticated user accounts and protected by database row-level security.
- Public product information is available on the pages linked above. Authenticated application routes are private and excluded from search indexing.
- Do not infer a user's health, diagnosis, identity, or personal history from NeuroMirror's product descriptions.
